name: ECO-M_PL_015_pollinators
description: Nodes represent pollinator species. Each hyperedge represents a plant species and contains the set of pollinators visiting that plant (projection of a plant–pollinator bipartite network). This dataset contains the relationships between plants and pollinators from the 'Web of Life' project.

hypergraph_metadata.weighted: (BOOL) Whether the hypergraph is weighted (e.g., false).

nodes_metadata.name: (STRING) Scientific name of the pollinator species (e.g., Apis mellifera).
nodes_metadata.original_node_id: (INT) Original node identifier from the source dataset (e.g., 7).

edges_metadata.name: (STRING) Scientific name of the plant species visited (e.g., Erodium cicutarium).
